  Exam Date & Time: 17-Jun-2025 (02:00 PM - 05:00 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester Makeup Examination, June -2025  
  BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE AND ANALYTICS [CSE-4018]  
  Marks: 50                                                                             Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           A pharmaceutical company wants to improve its decision-making process related to  
  drug inventory, distribution logistics, and market analysis. To achieve this, it plans to  
  implement a Decision Support System (DSS) as part of its Business Intelligence (BI)  
  A)      strategy. Explain the help of Decision support system in informed decision-making for a (5)  
  pharmaceutical company with its advantages of integrating DSS with BI tools for this  
  use case.  
  
  B)      A logistics company is facing challenges due to rising fuel costs, fluctuating customer  
  demands, and increased competition. The management is considering implementing a  
  Computerized Decision Support System (DSS) to adapt to these changing business          (5)  
  conditions. Explain how changing business environments affect the company's decision-  
  making and role of a computerized DSS in such a dynamic business setting.  
  
  2)           A retail company is facing inconsistent sales across regions. The analytics team is asked  
  to uncover insights to support decision-making. Explain the cycle of Business  
  Intelligence analysis from analysis till reports and how each stage helps solve the       (5)  
  A)      company's sales challenges.  
  
  B)      A company launched a new product based purely on market data without analysing  
  trends or drawing insights from past campaigns. The product failed to gain transaction.  
  In this failure context examine the role of data transformation into knowledge play and    (5)  
  mention how the better use of the data-information-knowledge hierarchy have changed  
  the outcome.  
  
  3)           A company is facing declining sales and wants to make informed decisions to improve  
  its performance. Explain how can data-driven decision-making processes be applied in  
  this scenario and how Business Intelligence tools can support effective business           (5)  
  A)      decision-making.  
  
  B)      Event-driven alerts are a critical style of Business Intelligence that enable real-time  
  decision-making. Explain how event-driven alerts function within a BI system, and  
  evaluate their impact on business operations by comparing them with other BI delivery      (5)  
  styles such as dashboards and reports.  
  
  4)           Assume the retail company xyz faces challenges in integrating data from multiple store (5)  
  locations and ensuring real-time analytics. So as a BI analyst list the four key benefits of  
  implementing BI system as solutions, major challenges the company may face during BI

  Explain the Hadoop ecosystem components you would use with a detailed diagram and

  its description in data storage and parallel processing.

  B)         A large hospital system wants to reduce emergency room overcrowding by predicting  
  which patients are likely to return within 30 days of discharge, based on electronic  
  health records (EHR), lab results, and wearable device data. Survey the types of               (5)

  also the tools or models to be employed.
